headline: HFCL and Sterlite Technologies Shares Fall 5% as AI and Data Center Sell-Off Resumes
summary: Shares of HFCL and Sterlite Technologies hit 5% lower circuits as a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks revived concerns over a slowdown in data center expansion.
why: Telecom infrastructure and optical fiber suppliers move in tandem with capital expenditure cycles in data center and AI deployments.

impacts.name: HFCL
impacts.why: Selling pressure in AI infrastructure stocks triggers lower circuit limits.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Renewed global sell-offs in artificial intelligence and data center equipment providers triggered sharp downward trading limits in Indian telecom suppliers.
